description:
"I’ll gladly fall for it. For you.” Moon Doha, the sole heir of the Imoon Group. “Your name is Lee Seulbi, correct?” “Yes… that’s right. But who are you?” A casino dealer known as Chloe is tasked with seducing a man who is still searching for his lover who died eight years ago— all to retrieve a certain item. ‘If I fail, Mama Kwan’s treatment will be for nothing.’ Her face, her voice, even her scent— everything about her reminds him of Lee Seulbi. Yet every circumstance insists that she is not the woman he’s looking for. “Fine. Go ahead.” “Do what?” “What you were planning to do to me.” Trusting his instincts, Doha willingly throws himself into the biggest gamble of his life— betting everything he has.
Source: MU
